levelup-dashboard-1.caption: The leadership dashboard: challenge status, AHT trend, adoption and engagement, and the live leaderboard.
levelup-dashboard-1.alt: LevelUp dashboard with challenge status, an AHT trend chart, adoption and engagement cards, and a live leaderboard of players with their 3D character avatars.

levelup-dashboard-2.caption: The same dashboard on a 1920 x 1080 floor TV.
levelup-dashboard-2.alt: The same LevelUp dashboard laid out for a 1920 x 1080 floor TV.

levelup-v1-1.caption: Before: version 1.1
levelup-v1-1.alt: Version 1.1 of LevelUp: a Sales Performance leaderboard for New York with photos, the top 5 ranks and progress bars for sales, revenue and follow-up contacts.

levelup-home-1.caption: After: the live product
levelup-home-1.alt: LevelUp home for an agent, with the group leaderboard in the centre and the agent's full-size 3D character beside a panel of their C-SAT, sales and AHT.

levelup-challenges-1.caption: Running challenges as game cards, each with its own countdown.
levelup-challenges-1.alt: Running challenges as three game-style cards, each with a countdown, the challenge type, the time window and the points for each reward level.

levelup-overlay-1.caption: Changing a date range covers the whole screen, the way a game would, to give players a moment to reset.
levelup-overlay-1.alt: A full-screen Select Date Range overlay with From Date and To Date fields, where a business app would use a small dropdown.

levelup-characters-1.caption: Some of the LevelUp characters, built in Ready Player Me and rigged for Three.js.
levelup-characters-1.alt: Sixteen of the LevelUp 3D characters, male and female, in two rows, each with a different outfit and style.

levelup-profile-1.caption: The profile: your character, your points, your KPIs, and every badge you have won.
levelup-profile-1.alt: An agent's profile with their 3D character, total points, KPI scores and the badges they have won, with a count for each.

levelup-wizard-1.caption: Goal Settings, with a live preview of the challenge card agents will see.
levelup-wizard-1.alt: Challenge wizard Goal Settings step with the KPI, points per unit, times, dates and repeat rule, and a live preview of the challenge card agents will see.

levelup-wizard-2.caption: Rewards for the top three, and for everyone else.
levelup-wizard-2.alt: Rewards step with traditional milestones for 1st, 2nd and 3rd position, and motivational rewards: Super Starter, Best Customer Feedback and Above and Beyond.

levelup-celebrate-1.caption: Every sale takes over the screen, then closes itself after a short countdown.
levelup-celebrate-1.alt: A full-screen New Sale celebration with the agent's 3D character, their rank and points, and a close button with a countdown.

levelup-celebrate-2.caption: When a challenge ends, the winners go to the Hall of Fame.
levelup-celebrate-2.alt: A Challenge Completed screen with the winners' characters and badges, and a button to the Hall of Fame.

levelup-admin-1.caption: Admins define each KPI once and reuse it across challenges.
levelup-admin-1.alt: Admin KPIs list with each KPI's name, who created it, when, and a link to configure it.

levelup-admin-2.caption: Bulk upload results, with each teammate's KPI values, targets and points.
levelup-admin-2.alt: Bulk upload results with one teammate's row open to show each KPI's value, target and points.
